roleSnippets.auto: -> MACHINE ROLE: infer the main use (gaming, coding/AI, creative, office, mobile) from the software and folders found in Phase 0; state the inference and confidence.
roleSnippets.gaming: -> MACHINE ROLE [GAMING]: prioritise stable FPS and frametime, fewer background apps while playing, GPU driver, Game Mode, HAGS, per-game GPU, XMP/EXPO (group M), heat and throttling. Never touch saves, mods or game settings; clean shader caches only when space is needed (games recompile them).
roleSnippets.dev: -> MACHINE ROLE [CODING, AI AND VMs]: look closely at WSL/Docker VHDX, Hyper-V/VirtualBox, npm/pnpm/yarn/pip/uv/conda/NuGet/Gradle/Maven/Cargo/Go caches, HuggingFace/Ollama/LM Studio models, node_modules/.venv/target untouched for 180+ days; propose moving caches to another drive via environment variables. Never touch source code, Git repos, existing environment variables, SSH/cloud keys, Docker volumes or running containers.
roleSnippets.creator: -> MACHINE ROLE [DESIGN AND VIDEO]: look closely at Adobe Media Cache/Peak Files/Scratch, Lightroom Previews, DaVinci CacheClip/Proxy, CapCut, Blender, OBS; propose caches on the fastest SSD or a second drive. Never delete projects, footage, source assets, fonts, presets or LUTs.
roleSnippets.office: -> MACHINE ROLE [OFFICE AND STUDY]: fast boot, smooth browser and Office, few background apps; check Zalo/Telegram/Teams/Zoom, OneDrive (Free up space only) and browser caches; keep every login, password and document.
roleSnippets.laptop: -> MACHINE ROLE [LAPTOP ON THE GO]: battery life, heat and noise first: report battery wear, background tasks that drain the battery, Power Mode on battery, a discrete GPU woken for no reason; keep Hibernate and the OEM battery/fan utility.
roleSnippets.lowspec: -> MACHINE ROLE [OLD OR WEAK PC / HDD]: cut background tasks, startup apps, effects and background browsers as far as possible; pagefile System Managed on the fastest drive; say plainly when an SSD or more RAM is the most effective fix.
roleSnippets.vm: -> MACHINE ROLE [VIRTUAL MACHINE / CLOUD PC]: skip temperature, SMART, BIOS, battery, Hibernate and GPU drivers; focus on background processes, services and disk space; compacting or growing virtual disks happens on the host.

scopeSnippets.full: -> SCOPE: Full diagnostic and storage review. (Scope=full)
scopeSnippets.health: -> SCOPE: Health-only read-only diagnostics; no mutation proposals. (Scope=health)
scopeSnippets.speed: -> SCOPE: Performance diagnostics and advice; skip detailed storage scans. (Scope=speed)
scopeSnippets.cleanup: -> SCOPE: Storage review with safety diagnostics; no automatic selection of personal data. (Scope=cleanup)

aggrSnippets.balanced: -> CLEANUP: Balanced review. Keep cache, application data, personal files and VM disks separate.
aggrSnippets.conservative: -> CLEANUP: Conservative. Retain useful caches unless space is needed; never preselect personal files.
aggrSnippets.deep: -> CLEANUP: Detailed storage review without relaxing path, approval or recovery limits. Relocation is advice unless a tested procedure is available.

modeSnippets.approve: -> AUTONOMY: propose by code, wait for my approval and CONFIRM before doing anything.
modeSnippets.audit: -> AUTONOMY: AUDIT AND PROPOSE ONLY. Stop after Phase 1; do not run Phase 2 even if I approve, unless I clearly say "Unlock execution".

blockHeader: === MY PROFILE (APPLIED ON TOP OF THE HARD SAFETY RULES, NEVER OVERRIDING THEM) ===

extraTpl.drive: -> RELOCATION ADVICE ONLY: consider {v}; quarantine must remain on the source volume.
extraTpl.protect: -> NEVER TOUCH (measure only, never propose deleting, moving or disabling): {v}

reportSnippets.simple: -> REPORT: Simple HTML report without animation. (ReportMode=simple)
reportSnippets.none: -> REPORT: Do not create or open HTML. Keep JSON state and plans. (ReportMode=none)

budgetSnippets.balanced: -> BUDGET: Balanced scan; concise structured results and evidence. (MaxSeconds=180)
budgetSnippets.thorough: -> BUDGET: Longer read-only scan and detailed explanations where useful; preserve all safety limits. (MaxSeconds=600)
